lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The centroids are arranged in a staggered formation where spot diameter increases along the posterior-horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where the highest-intensity maxima are centered at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the lateral flank, defined by a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the superior surface to a shadow-induced low-intensity gradient on the inferior surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, non-grid-aligned high-luminance spots compared to the structured arrangement found on the lateral flank.
